styles.css: /* wp-ja-diner: colours in both modes. The source (JA Diner 1.0.4, Joomla 6 T3) has no dark mode; light = tokens.css, measured on the running source (21/10/2026), and every value reads the worn design system first (var(--ds-c-<role>, <the template colour>)) as the 1.0.4 sheets do. Dark is DERIVED (DECISIONS D-03): page #1a1816, white boxes #24211e, text #c9c3ba, headings #f2eee8, borders #3d3833; the accent #c36349 and the highlight yellow #ffcc00 stay. No attribute = auto, the OS decides; assets/js/wp-ja-diner-dark.js writes data-theme light|dark from the tracy_theme cookie before the first paint. */ :root{color-scheme:light dark;--jd-yellow:var(--ds-c-accent-text, #ffcc00);--wp--preset--color--bg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-bg, #fcfaf6),var(--ds-c-bg, #1a1816));--wp--preset--color--surface:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-surface, #24211e));--wp--preset--color--surface-warm:light-dark(var(--ds-c-ink, #222222),var(--ds-c-ink, #0f0e0d));--wp--preset--color--fg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-fg, #555555),var(--ds-c-fg, #c9c3ba));--wp--preset--color--fg-2:light-dark(var(--ds-c-heading, #222222),var(--ds-c-heading, #f2eee8));--wp--preset--color--muted:light-dark(var(--ds-c-muted, #555555),var(--ds-c-muted, #b3aca2));--wp--preset--color--meta:light-dark(var(--ds-c-meta, #999999),var(--ds-c-meta, #8f887e));--wp--preset--color--border:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border, #e8e6e3),var(--ds-c-border, #3d3833));--wp--preset--color--border-soft:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border-soft, #c2c0be),var(--ds-c-border-soft, #5a544d));--wp--preset--color--accent:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent, #c36349),var(--ds-c-accent, #c36349));--wp--preset--color--accent-on:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff));--wp--preset--color--accent-hover:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #a34d36),var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #e08a70));--wp--preset--color--accent-active:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-active, #a34d36),var(--ds-c-accent-active, #e08a70));}:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:light}:root[data-theme="dark"]{color-scheme:dark}
